nora: Quick q — Maya's birthday is Friday. Small in-office thing? :confetti_ball:
devin: I'm leaning coffee cart + bagels so remote folks can join via care package option
maya: lol i'm fine either way, honestly no big spectacle :sunglasses:
sam: +1 coffee cart. also e-gift option for folks remote? :coffee:
hr-bot: Reminder: Maya's birthday — Fri 10:30am. Add to calendar: https://calendar.redwood/evt/1823459100
nora: options poll: :coffee: coffee cart / :bagel: bagels + pastries / :gift: e-gift card
devin: :coffee:
sam: :coffee:
maya: :bagel: (i actually like everything)
nora: ok current 2 coffee, 1 bagel. vote closes Thu 5pm
devin: dietary note: two gluten-free bagels pls if we go bagels (and one almond milk for lattes)
sam: i can coordinate coffee cart if coffee wins — i'll schedule with BrewGo
nora: pricing rough estimate from BrewGo: $120 for 30 people (basic setup) — lmk if that's okay
sam: sounds reasonable, i'll confirm availability and add tip
nora: remote folks: would you prefer an e-gift or a mailed pastry box? reply: :e-gift: / :box:
jenna: :e-gift:
omar: :box: (i love pastries)
maya: whatever y'all pick is sweet. also if there's a card feel free to add notes here
devin: "Happy birthday! thanks for all the routing policy help :)"
sam: "Hope your day is full of low latencies and high coffee!"
nora: i'll bring a small card and markers. sam will coordinate BrewGo if coffee wins; devin will arrange GF bagels if bagels wins
hr-bot: Calendar updated: Maya Birthday — Fri 10:30 (Room A) https://calendar.redwood/evt/1823459100
nora: final call — coffee cart wins 3:1. sam plz confirm BrewGo pickup Fri 10:15. closing thread, thanks! :tada:
